🎙Teun #Koopmeiners on @DAZN_IT:#ALAJBEGOVIC"Yes, he is a good guy, we need this energy.He is young, it is not easy for him to arrive at this club, but we needed him and he did very well."IS A NEW #JUVE BEGINNING?"Yes, it's true, we talked a lot during these past days, we talked about mentality, about the mindset, because you can make technical or tactical mistakes sometimes, but you can never make a mistake in your mentality.The team that played against #Genoa was not #Juventus.We spoke the truth in the locker room and I believe today is a good start, this is how we have to play every match."[@PuebloJ]

🎙Kerim #Alajbegovic on @DAZN_IT:FIRST GOAL IN SERIE A"Yes, I am very happy about my first goal in Serie A, also because the team has been through weeks that were not easy at all, so I am even happier."RELATIONSHIP WITH #SPALLETTI "#Spalletti is a great coach, he always helps me to improve and #Koopmeiners is also a great player, he's a good guy.I dedicate the goal to my family."[@PuebloJ]

A Stroke Of Genius From Ala And #Juve Rises Again#Spalletti Puts #Allegri In Trouble#Lazio is alone at the topA fantastic goal by #Alajbegović (who later went off with a calf injury) bends #Meret and #Napoli, finally electrifying the Stadium after the heavy pre-match protest. The second goal by #Boga, beautiful once again, came after #Marianucci's red card. #Mckennie and #Cabal are also KO.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🎙Luciano #Spalletti on @DAZN_IT:DRAGGING #DOMENICHINI BACK"It has a different meaning because they suffer with me, they are there working from morning to night alongside me. I am the first to arrive and the last to leave, but they are almost there the entire day.And besides, they care about our fate... you work, you go out there, but tonight the credit must be given to the team, which managed to tap into that willingness to take the first step, to try to win meters, even just imagining them, to move forward.And then in the second half, they managed it by fixing a few things.For me, tonight they deserved the victory again and won back a bit of the esteem they deserve for the level of football

🎙Jeremie #Boga on @DAZN_IT:A MATCH RESOLVED BY 2 MOMENTS OF INDIVIDUAL BRILLIANCE"Yes, it's normal, when you play at #Juve, when the results are not there, everyone is questioned.It's normal to work, show that we have the quality and play with our heart like we did today, all together.Today needs to serve as an example of how we play and how we fight.We can still improve with the ball, that's for sure, but in terms of heart, we played a good match."HOW MUCH DID YOU NEED A NIGHT LIKE THIS?"It's true, it is very important for me, it's my first goal this year. Now I need to find continuity physically as well, but it gives me a lot of confidence and I am very happy for the team and for these thr
Kerim Alajbegović is the Panini Player of the Match 🏆#JuveNapoli[SerieA]

#JuventusNapoli | 🟥 In the 10th minute, a red card was demanded for #Koopmeiners for this foul on #Anguissa (📸 DAZN).Sozza certainly makes a mistake by not blowing the whistle at all but, while the first freeze-frame might make one think of a serious foul play, the dynamics tell a different story: #Anguissa miscontrols the ball, the ball is "loose" and the two stretch out to challenge for it. The azzurro player arrives first and the bianconero player does not plunge into the leg beneath him, but slides down the calf, eventually ending on the lower part.🟨 A yellow card yes, but not a red one in my opinion.#juventus #SSCNapoli #SerieAEnilive[Denis Errori Arbitrali]

Notes from the end of #Juve-#Napoli: at the final whistle, #Spalletti forcefully called back #Domenichini who was heading to the locker room. Then, a collective group hug in a circle with all the staff.Ice pack for #Alajbegović[IlBianconero]

19&41 - Kerim #Alajbegovic (19 years 41 days) is the youngest foreign goalscorer to score in the match between #Juventus and #Napoli in Serie A; overall he is the 3rd youngest, after Bruno Nicolè in 1958 (18y 230d) and Felice Placido Borel in 1933 (18y 334d). Gem.#JuveNapoli[Opta Paolo]
